prompt: Define restrained motion for a keyboard-first task manager: save feedback, list insertion, destructive confirmation, and a route transition. Include causal order, duration/easing, interruption, performance, a genuinely equivalent reduced-motion path, and JS-disabled safe reveal.
assertions: Every animation has a user-facing purpose; committed state and focus precede optional feedback, with an interruption that converges on the usable state.
Timing and easing use concrete token-backed duration bands for Save, insertion, destructive confirmation, and route continuity.

Produces five distinct replayable evidence rows: Save, insertion, destructive confirmation, route, and global reduced-motion/JS-disabled safety; each has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance.
Save proves latest-request-only settlement by replaying both stale success and stale error after a newer request begins; only the latest request owns visible status and its single live announcement.
Reduced motion preserves comprehension and completion without merely hiding content; spatial movement is gated by no-preference and JS-disabled content remains revealed.

Explicitly rejects component-states as the negative neighbor because it owns the state model rather than motion timing, causal order, or interruption; hands final focus/live-region verification to a11y-pass.
required_evidence: Save replay: N then N+1; settle stale N as success and error without a status change or live announcement.
Insertion replay: insert then sort or navigate; final DOM order stays readable.
Destructive-confirmation replay: Escape, Cancel, repeat delete, and navigation converge on the closed focused state.
Route replay: a second navigation wins without a stale layer; destination DOM and heading focus are ready.
Global safety replay: compositor-only properties, reduced motion, and JS-disabled reveal are checked.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (component-states) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
